hook.en: You do not build a power station to switch on a fan; you pay for the units you use. What if storage and software worked the same way?
hook.kn: ಫ್ಯಾನ್ ಹಾಕಲು ನೀವು ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಕಟ್ಟುವುದಿಲ್ಲ; ಬಳಸಿದ ಯೂನಿಟ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ ಹಣ ಕೊಡುತ್ತೀರಿ. ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ತಂತ್ರಾಂಶವೂ ಹಾಗೆಯೇ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ?

narration.en: You do not build a power station to switch on a fan; you pay for the units you use. What if storage and software worked the same way?
narration.kn: ಫ್ಯಾನ್ ಹಾಕಲು ನೀವು ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಕಟ್ಟುವುದಿಲ್ಲ; ಬಳಸಿದ ಯೂನಿಟ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ ಹಣ ಕೊಡುತ್ತೀರಿ. ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ತಂತ್ರಾಂಶವೂ ಹಾಗೆಯೇ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ?

body.en: Cloud computing delivers computing resources, such as servers, storage, databases, software and networking, over the Internet on demand, usually paid for as they are used. The three main services are: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), which provides virtual machines, storage and networks; Platform as a Service (PaaS), which provides a ready environment with operating system, database and tools for developers to build and deploy applications; and Software as a Service (SaaS), which provides complete applications used through a browser, such as online email and office suites.

points.en: IaaS: virtual hardware (computing power, storage, network)
PaaS: platform and tools for developers
SaaS: ready-to-use software via the browser

narration.en: Cloud computing delivers computing resources, such as servers, storage, databases, software and networking, over the Internet on demand, usually paid for as they are used. The three main services are: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), which provides virtual machines, storage and networks; Platform as a Service (PaaS), which provides a ready environment with operating system, database and tools for developers to build and deploy applications; and Software as a Service (SaaS), which provides complete applications used through a browser, such as online email and office suites.
narration.kn: ಕ್ಲೌಡ್ ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟಿಂಗ್ ಸರ್ವರ್, ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣೆ, ತಂತ್ರಾಂಶ ಮುಂತಾದ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲಗಳನ್ನು ಅಂತರ್ಜಾಲದ ಮೂಲಕ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯಂತೆ ಒದಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. IaaS ವರ್ಚುವಲ್ ಯಂತ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ; PaaS ಅಪ್ಲಿಕೇಶನ್ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲು ವೇದಿಕೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ; SaaS ಬ್ರೌಸರ್ ಮೂಲಕ ಸಿದ್ಧ ತಂತ್ರಾಂಶ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: Cloud service models

say.en: In cloud computing we rent computing over the Internet and pay for what we use.
Infrastructure as a Service gives only virtual machines, storage and networks. You install everything else.
Platform as a Service adds the operating system and development tools, so programmers just write and deploy their apps.
Software as a Service gives a ready application, like online documents in a browser.
A public cloud is open to anyone; a private cloud serves one organisation that wants more control.

text.en: Public: open to all. Private: one firm

narration.en: We stack the three cloud services, IaaS, PaaS and SaaS, and see how much the provider manages in each.

prompt.en: Which cloud service is being used in each case?
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವ ಕ್ಲೌಡ್ ಸೇವೆ ಬಳಸಲಾಗಿದೆ?

text.en: Renting a virtual machine with 8 CPUs for a week
Buying 2 TB of online storage space for backups
Renting virtual servers and networks to host a company's own OS
A ready environment with OS, database and tools to build and deploy a web app
Deploying your Python app without managing any server or OS
Writing a document in an online office suite in the browser
Running a school's attendance app used only through the browser

explanation.en: IaaS gives raw computing power, storage and networks; PaaS gives a ready platform for developers to build and deploy apps; SaaS gives complete applications used through a browser.
explanation.kn: IaaS ಕಚ್ಚಾ ಗಣನಾ ಶಕ್ತಿ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ; PaaS ಆ್ಯಪ್ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸುವ ವೇದಿಕೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ; SaaS ಬ್ರೌಸರ್ ಮೂಲಕ ಬಳಸುವ ಪೂರ್ಣ ತಂತ್ರಾಂಶ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: A public cloud is owned by a provider and offers its services to anyone over the Internet. A private cloud is used by a single organisation, such as a bank, which wants more control and security over its data. The user of the cloud does not need to buy or maintain the hardware.

points.en: Public cloud: shared, open to all customers
Private cloud: one organisation, more control

narration.en: A public cloud is owned by a provider and offers its services to anyone over the Internet. A private cloud is used by a single organisation, such as a bank, which wants more control and security over its data. The user of the cloud does not need to buy or maintain the hardware.
narration.kn: ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಕ್ಲೌಡ್ ಯಾರಿಗೂ ಸೇವೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಖಾಸಗಿ ಕ್ಲೌಡ್ ಒಂದೇ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಬಳಕೆಗೆ, ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಮತ್ತು ಸುರಕ್ಷತೆಗಾಗಿ.

title.en: Buy a server or rent the cloud?

caption.en: Buying a server costs a lot at once plus a small running cost each month; the cloud costs a fixed amount each month. The lines cross at the break-even month.

tryThis.en: For a project of only 6 months, which choice is cheaper?
Make the cloud bill bigger: does the break-even come earlier or later?
Why do start-ups often choose the cloud first?

narration.en: Buying a server costs a lot at once plus a small running cost each month; the cloud costs a fixed amount each month. The lines cross at the break-even month. For a project of only 6 months, which choice is cheaper?

problem.en: Classify each as IaaS, PaaS or SaaS: (a) renting a virtual server to host a website (b) using an online word processor in a browser (c) a platform where a developer uploads code and it runs with a ready database.

steps.en: (a) gives raw computing infrastructure, so it is IaaS.
(b) gives finished software used through a browser, so it is SaaS.
(c) gives a development and runtime platform, so it is PaaS.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. Classify each as IaaS, PaaS or SaaS: (a) renting a virtual server to host a website (b) using an online word processor in a browser (c) a platform where a developer uploads code and it runs with a ready database.

body.en: IaaS is renting a kitchen: you bring the recipe and cook. PaaS is a kitchen with ingredients ready: you only cook. SaaS is ordering the pizza: you just eat.

narration.en: Pizza as a service. IaaS is renting a kitchen: you bring the recipe and cook. PaaS is a kitchen with ingredients ready: you only cook. SaaS is ordering the pizza: you just eat.

mnemonic.en: Infrastructure → Platform → Software: you do less at each step
